features.name: Clean Architecture
features.subtitle: Architecture & Structure
features.implementationDetails: Separation of concerns using the Repository pattern and Use Cases. The domain layer remains independent of UI and Frameworks.

bestPractices.title: Dependency Inversion
bestPractices.description: High-level modules should not depend on low-level modules. Both should depend on abstractions.

bestPractices.title: Single Responsibility
bestPractices.description: Each file and class should have one reason to change, ensuring focused code.

bestPractices.title: Model Decoupling
bestPractices.description: Keep Domain entities pure. Use DTOs for networking and UI-specific models.

features.name: MVVM Pattern
features.subtitle: Architecture & Structure
features.implementationDetails: Model-View-ViewModel architecture with @Observable for reactive state management. Views observe ViewModel state changes automatically.

bestPractices.title: Observable State
bestPractices.description: Use @Observable macro instead of @Published for modern SwiftUI state management.

bestPractices.title: State Enum
bestPractices.description: Define view states as an enum (idle, loading, loaded, error) for clear state handling.

bestPractices.title: No Business Logic in Views
bestPractices.description: Keep Views declarative. All business logic belongs in ViewModels or UseCases.

features.name: Dependency Injection
features.subtitle: Architecture & Structure
features.implementationDetails: Factory-based dependency injection without third-party frameworks. Each feature has its own factory that wires dependencies.

bestPractices.title: Protocol Abstraction
bestPractices.description: Always inject protocols, not concrete implementations. This enables testing and flexibility.

bestPractices.title: No Singletons
bestPractices.description: Avoid singletons for repositories and use cases. Use dependency injection instead.

bestPractices.title: Factory Encapsulation
bestPractices.description: Keep factory methods private except for view creation. Internal wiring stays hidden.

features.name: Router Navigation
features.subtitle: Navigation & Routing
features.implementationDetails: Type-erased router pattern with feature-specific route enums. AppRouter handles navigation stack, features define their own routes.

bestPractices.title: Codable Routes
bestPractices.description: Route enums must be Codable for NavigationPath state preservation.

bestPractices.title: Feature Isolation
bestPractices.description: Each feature defines its own routes. AppRouter doesn't know about specific feature routes.

bestPractices.title: Two File Pattern
bestPractices.description: Navigation uses 2 files per feature: Router.swift (routes + protocol) and RouteResolver.swift.

features.name: SwiftUI Views
features.subtitle: User Interface
features.implementationDetails: Declarative UI with SwiftUI. One View per file, custom ViewModifiers extracted to Core, feature components in dedicated folder.

bestPractices.title: Small Body
bestPractices.description: Keep body small. Extract complex layouts to private computed properties or subviews.

bestPractices.title: Task for Loading
bestPractices.description: Use .task(id:) modifier for data loading, not loose Task { } blocks.

bestPractices.title: Extracted Modifiers
bestPractices.description: Custom ViewModifiers go in Core/Common/SwiftUI/Modifiers/, never inline.

features.name: Design System
features.subtitle: User Interface
features.implementationDetails: Centralized design tokens for colors, typography, spacing, and icons. Ensures visual consistency across the app.

bestPractices.title: Semantic Colors
bestPractices.description: Use semantic color names (primary, background) not literal colors (blue, white).

bestPractices.title: Consistent Spacing
bestPractices.description: Use Spacing enum values (xs, sm, md, lg) instead of magic numbers.

bestPractices.title: System Dark Mode
bestPractices.description: Respect system appearance preference. Don't create custom dark mode toggles.

features.name: Networking Layer
features.subtitle: Data & Networking
features.implementationDetails: Generic API client with async/await. Endpoints define path, method, and response type. Centralized error handling.

bestPractices.title: Generic Endpoints
bestPractices.description: Endpoints are generic over response type. Compile-time safety for API contracts.

bestPractices.title: Error Mapping
bestPractices.description: Map APIError to DomainError to ErrorDecorator. Each layer has its own error type.

bestPractices.title: Sendable Compliance
bestPractices.description: All networking types must be Sendable for Swift 6 concurrency safety.

features.name: SwiftData Persistence
features.subtitle: Data & Persistence
features.implementationDetails: SwiftData for local persistence. SDModels stay in Data layer. Repositories use ModelExecutor for background access.

bestPractices.title: Data Layer Only
bestPractices.description: SwiftData imports only in Data layer. Domain and Presentation never import SwiftData.

bestPractices.title: Model Executor
bestPractices.description: Use ModelExecutor for background operations. Never access ModelContext from background threads.

bestPractices.title: ID-Based References
bestPractices.description: Don't pass SwiftData models between actors. Pass IDs and fetch on target context.

features.name: SSL Pinning
features.subtitle: Security
features.implementationDetails: Certificate pinning using URLSessionDelegate. Validates server certificates against bundled public keys.

bestPractices.title: Public Key Pinning
bestPractices.description: Pin to public keys, not full certificates. Allows certificate rotation without app updates.

bestPractices.title: Backup Pins
bestPractices.description: Include backup pins for certificate rotation scenarios. Prevents lockout.

bestPractices.title: Debug Bypass
bestPractices.description: Consider debug-only bypass for development. Never ship with pinning disabled.

features.name: Swift Testing
features.subtitle: Testing
features.implementationDetails: Swift Testing framework (import Testing) for unit tests. Mocks for all protocols. Tests mirror source structure.

bestPractices.title: Swift Testing Framework
bestPractices.description: Use import Testing, not XCTest. Modern macros like @Test and #expect.

bestPractices.title: Protocol Mocks
bestPractices.description: Create mock implementations for all protocols. Store in Tests/Mocks/ folder.

bestPractices.title: Test Structure Mirrors Source
bestPractices.description: Test folder structure matches source. Tests/Features/Article/ViewModels/ArticleViewModelTests.swift.

features.name: Feature-Based Structure
features.subtitle: Architecture & Structure
features.implementationDetails: Modular organization where each feature is self-contained. Features own their UI, Presentation, DI, and Navigation layers. Domain and Data layers remain global but organized by feature name.

bestPractices.title: Single Feature Ownership
bestPractices.description: Each feature folder owns all its presentation code. No cross-feature imports within Features/.

bestPractices.title: Feature Isolation
bestPractices.description: Features communicate through navigation (routes) or shared Domain models, never directly.

bestPractices.title: Vertical Slicing
bestPractices.description: New features add vertical slices (new folders) rather than modifying existing horizontal layers.

features.name: @Observable Macro
features.subtitle: State Management
features.implementationDetails: Modern reactivity macro that replaces @Published and ObservableObject. Views use @State to hold @Observable classes. Automatic observation tracking without explicit property wrappers.

bestPractices.title: No @StateObject
bestPractices.description: Never use @StateObject or @ObservedObject with @Observable. Use @State instead.

bestPractices.title: @MainActor Isolation
bestPractices.description: Always mark ViewModels with @MainActor for thread-safe UI state updates.

bestPractices.title: Private(set) Properties
bestPractices.description: Use private(set) for state properties. Views should not mutate ViewModel state directly.

features.name: Custom ViewModifiers
features.subtitle: UI Patterns
features.implementationDetails: All custom ViewModifiers are extracted to Core/Common/SwiftUI/Modifiers/. Never define modifiers inline in Views. Promotes reusability and keeps Views clean.

bestPractices.title: Extract Inline Modifiers
bestPractices.description: If you chain more than 3-4 modifiers repeatedly, extract to a custom ViewModifier.

bestPractices.title: Core Location
bestPractices.description: All reusable modifiers live in Core/Common/SwiftUI/Modifiers/, not in feature folders.

bestPractices.title: Composable Design
bestPractices.description: Design modifiers to be composable. Each modifier should do one thing well.

features.name: State Separation
features.subtitle: ViewModel Patterns
features.implementationDetails: State enum and Decorator structs are in separate files from ViewModel. State enum represents view states (idle, loading, loaded, error). Decorators are UI-ready models with formatted data.

bestPractices.title: State Enum Only
bestPractices.description: State file contains only the state enum. No Action or Event enums.

bestPractices.title: No Action Enums
bestPractices.description: Actions are direct methods on ViewModel, not enum cases to dispatch.

bestPractices.title: Decorators for UI
bestPractices.description: Decorators contain formatted, localized, UI-ready data. No formatting logic in Views.

features.name: Endpoint Builder
features.subtitle: API Patterns
features.implementationDetails: Generic Endpoint struct parameterized by Response type. Compile-time type safety ensures correct response decoding. Static endpoint definitions per feature.

bestPractices.title: Generic Over Response
bestPractices.description: Endpoint is generic over Response type. This provides compile-time safety for API contracts.

bestPractices.title: Static Endpoint Definitions
bestPractices.description: Define endpoints as static properties or functions in a namespace enum per feature.

bestPractices.title: Type-Safe Contracts
bestPractices.description: The generic type ensures APIClient.request returns the correct type without casting.

features.name: Typed Errors
features.subtitle: Error Handling
features.implementationDetails: Each layer has its own typed error enum. Data layer uses APIError, Domain layer uses feature-specific errors. No generic String errors or untyped throws.

bestPractices.title: Layer-Specific Errors
bestPractices.description: Each layer defines its own error types. Don't leak APIError to Domain or Presentation.

bestPractices.title: No try?
bestPractices.description: Avoid try? which silences errors. Always handle errors explicitly or propagate them.

bestPractices.title: Equatable Errors
bestPractices.description: Make errors Equatable for easy testing and state comparison.

features.name: Error Mapping
features.subtitle: Error Flow
features.implementationDetails: Errors transform at layer boundaries: APIError → DomainError in Repository, DomainError → ErrorDecorator in ViewModel. Each transformation adds context appropriate to that layer.

bestPractices.title: Transform at Boundaries
bestPractices.description: Map errors when crossing layer boundaries (Repository, ViewModel), not inline.

bestPractices.title: Localized Messages in UI
bestPractices.description: Only ErrorDecorator contains localized user-facing messages. Domain errors are technical.

bestPractices.title: isRetryable Flag
bestPractices.description: Include isRetryable in ErrorDecorator so Views can show/hide retry buttons.

features.name: Pokemon API Example
features.subtitle: API Integration
features.implementationDetails: Real-world API integration with PokeAPI. Uses paginated endpoint with limit/offset, parallel detail fetching via TaskGroup, and DTO-to-Domain mapping. Demonstrates the full Data layer flow: Endpoint → RemoteDataSource → Repository → UseCase.

bestPractices.title: Paginated Fetching
bestPractices.description: Use limit/offset pagination to load data incrementally. Avoid loading all data at once.

bestPractices.title: Parallel Requests
bestPractices.description: Use TaskGroup for concurrent detail fetches. Handle individual failures gracefully without failing the batch.

bestPractices.title: Cancellation Propagation
bestPractices.description: Always propagate CancellationError. Log non-fatal errors but don't swallow cancellation.

features.name: Background Executor
features.subtitle: SwiftData Concurrency
features.implementationDetails: SwiftData repositories use ModelExecutor for background operations. Never access the main ModelContext from background threads. Each repository receives its own executor instance from the factory.

bestPractices.title: Never Main Context
bestPractices.description: Background operations must use ModelExecutor, never the main ModelContext.

bestPractices.title: Pass IDs Not Models
bestPractices.description: Don't pass SwiftData models between actors. Pass IDs and fetch on the target context.

bestPractices.title: Dedicated Executor Per Repo
bestPractices.description: Each repository gets its own executor instance to avoid context conflicts.

features.name: Environment Config
features.subtitle: Build Configuration
features.implementationDetails: Environment-specific configuration using xcconfig files. Different base URLs, feature flags, and API keys per build scheme (Dev, Staging, Prod). No hardcoded values in code.

bestPractices.title: No Hardcoded URLs
bestPractices.description: Never hardcode API URLs in code. Use Environment or xcconfig values.

bestPractices.title: Xcconfig for Secrets
bestPractices.description: Store API keys in xcconfig files excluded from git. Reference via Info.plist.

bestPractices.title: Current Environment Pattern
bestPractices.description: Access current config via AppEnvironment.current. Single source of truth.

features.name: Testable Architecture
features.subtitle: Testing Patterns
features.implementationDetails: Architecture designed for testability. Every dependency has a protocol. Mocks implement protocols with configurable behavior. Test folder structure mirrors source structure.

bestPractices.title: Protocol for Every Dependency
bestPractices.description: Every injected dependency has a protocol. This enables mock injection in tests.

bestPractices.title: Stub Factory Methods
bestPractices.description: Add static .stub() methods to domain models for easy test data creation.

bestPractices.title: Mirror Folder Structure
bestPractices.description: Tests/Features/Article/ViewModels/ mirrors Features/Article/Presentation/ViewModels/.
